assurance_contract.scope: Bounded compatibility and human-impact assessment of identity assertions when carried with C2PA provenance claims.
assurance_contract.non_scope: Deployment-specific identity proofing and trust-list operations outside the pinned specifications.
scenarios: A consumer interprets identity information attached to provenance-bearing content.
harms: consumer is induced to trust a person or organization beyond the assurance actually established
assurance_propositions: C2PA provenance and CAWG identity assertions must remain semantically distinct and must not silently amplify one another's assurance claims.
cross_spec_assumptions: Component conformance does not establish composition-level identity assurance.

harm_traceability.harm: over-trust from conflated provenance and identity semantics
harm_traceability.proposition: provenance must not silently amplify identity assurance
harm_traceability.control: explicit composition semantics and consumer-facing distinction between provenance and identity assurance

actions.action: Preserve explicit UI and specification language distinguishing provenance integrity from identity assurance.
actions.acceptance_criterion: A conforming presentation cannot represent provenance validity alone as proof of the asserted actor's broader identity trustworthiness.
